severity_minimization.note: v58 adds source paper-core collision/post-impact computation yet accelerates via vectorized SAT screening and first-impact-only polygon clipping.

compensatory_postimpact_mpc.note: No defensible new equations were added; small difference is benchmark noise. v57 predictor-free fast path retained.

betop_topology_preprocess.note: candidate-independent actor/map sorting and scene context are cached once per group.

wayformer_runtime_projection.note: This is not a v57-to-v58 speedup. It quantifies the explicit v58 runtime projection (96 latent queries, 2 decoder layers) against the paper-scale operator budget (192, 8) under the same v58 implementation.
